title: Parallelizable Probabilistic Latent Reasoning for Diverse Reasoning Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2610.29385v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models relying on verbalized Chain-of-Thought (CoT) are constrained to token-by-token generation in the language space, where many tokens serve textual coherence rather than core reasoning. This entangles genuine differences in logical trajectories with superficial variations in verbalization. Moving reasoning into a compact, continuous latent space offers a promising alternative for efficiently representing and exploring diverse reasoning trajectories. However, current latent models remain largely deterministic, capturing only a single reasoning trajectory rather than modeling a distribution over multiple valid alternatives. While stochastic approaches parameterize distributions over latent reasoning steps, they frequently suffer from unstable optimization and limited empirical performance. translated_title: 面向多样化推理轨迹的可并行化概率潜在推理
translated_abstract: 依赖语言化思维链的语言模型受限于在语言空间中逐个token的生成方式，其中许多token仅服务于文本连贯性而非核心推理。这使得逻辑轨迹上的真实差异与语言表达的表面变化纠缠在一起。将推理转移到紧凑的连续潜在空间中，为高效表示和探索多样化推理轨迹提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，当前的潜在模型大多仍是确定性的，只能捕获单一推理轨迹，而无法对多个有效备选方案的分布进行建模。虽然随机方法对潜在推理步骤的分布进行了参数化，但它们常常面临优化不稳定和实际性能有限的问题。此外，它们在训练过程中依赖自回归的潜在预测，阻碍了有效的并行化，导致了令人难以承受的（训练开销）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可并行的概率潜在推理方法，通过在紧凑连续的潜在空间中对多个有效推理轨迹的分布进行建模，既实现了多样化推理轨迹的探索，又支持高效的并行化训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a parallelizable probabilistic latent reasoning approach that models distributions over multiple valid reasoning trajectories in a compact continuous latent space, enabling both exploration of diverse reasoning paths and efficient parallelized training.
